pr_title: [BugFix][CI] Add E2E for kv sliding window; fix block size input bug
source_quote: I think you should add a check to see if the drafter's backend is FIA.

rule.description: 在 speculative decoding 中启用特定功能（如 KV sliding window）时，应检查 drafter 的 backend 类型是否兼容，避免在不支持的 backend 下出现运行时错误。
checkpoints: 检查功能是否仅在特定 backend 下可用
确认添加了 backend 类型的前置检查
对于不兼容的情况，提供清晰的错误提示

antipattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py L330-L355
# load_model 方法中 sliding window 初始化段（commit 3c4ee3a 之前）
def load_model(self, model_config: ModelConfig) -> None:
    """Load the model and initialize the sliding window adapter."""
    # ... model loading logic ...
    self.model = get_model(model_config)

    # KV sliding window: initialize draft attention adapter
    # No backend check — applied unconditionally to all drafter backends
    if self.use_sliding_window:
        self.draft_window_size = self.runner.model_config.hf_config.get(
            "sliding_window_size", None
        )
        self.sliding_window = self.runner.model_config.hf_config.get(
            "sliding_window", None
        )
        # Initialize sliding window draft attention adapter
        # using kernel_block_size for block size
        block_size = self.runner.block_size
        self.draft_attn_adapter = SlidingWindowDraftAttentionAdapter(
            draft_window_size=self.draft_window_size,
            block_size=block_size,
        )
        # ↑↑ 问题：未检查 drafter backend 是否为 FIA（Flash Inference Attention）
        #    非 FIA backend 下应用 sliding window 会导致运行时错误

pattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py L330-L360
# load_model 方法中 sliding window 初始化段（commit 3c4ee3a 添加 backend 检查）
def load_model(self, model_config: ModelConfig) -> None:
    """Load the model and initialize the sliding window adapter."""
    # ... model loading logic ...
    self.model = get_model(model_config)

    # KV sliding window: initialize draft attention adapter
    # Now checks drafter backend compatibility before applying
    if self.use_sliding_window:
        drafter_backend = self.get_drafter_backend()
        if drafter_backend != "FIA":
            logger.warning(
                "KV sliding window is only supported with FIA "
                "(Flash Inference Attention) backend. "
                "Current backend: %s. Skipping sliding window.",
                drafter_backend,
            )
            self.use_sliding_window = False
        else:
            self.draft_window_size = self.runner.model_config.hf_config.get(
                "sliding_window_size", None
            )
            self.sliding_window = self.runner.model_config.hf_config.get(
                "sliding_window", None
            )
            block_size = self.runner.block_size
            self.draft_attn_adapter = SlidingWindowDraftAttentionAdapter(
                draft_window_size=self.draft_window_size,
                block_size=block_size,
            )
